caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing human figure positioned on a green, rocky base. The figure is dressed in a long, reddish-brown garment with matching pants, and a green belt or sash around the waist. A generic reddish cloak drapes over the shoulders and down the back. The statue holds a long stick or staff in its right hand, extending from the waist up. The head is adorned with a headband featuring several large, brown and yellow feathers projecting upwards. The figure has long, straight, dark hair extending to the shoulders. There is a round, ornamental object on the right breast area, colored black with a red element inside. The overall color palette includes earth tones such as reddish-brown, green, beige, and dark brown, and the figure stands against a plain, light background.
title: Cigar Store Indian
